Name: More Saloon Music
Author: DeathDaisy69
Description:
[quote]The saloon can get pretty lively at night. Sometimes we even put a coin in the jukebox *chuckle*[/quote][size=4][b]-Lewis[/b][/size]

[size=4]That's a [i]lie[/i], Lewis. [/size]
[s]                                                                                                                      [/s]
[size=3]Or at least it was! Make the saloon feel more alive with a list of random tracks, made from various midi tracks, modified where necessary to fit the vanilla style better. Special, more high energy tracks for Friday nights for that weekend feel![/size]

Song list:
[b]Most days[/b]
[list]
[*]What's Yours Is Mine from Monaco
[*]Prison Life from Monaco
[*]Western themed personal composition
[*]Cantina from Star Wars
[*]Theme from Paperboy 2
[*]Loch Lomond - Folksong
[*]Personal piano composition
[*]Epona's Song from Zelda: OoT
[*]Hårgalåten - Folksong
[*]Mill Theme from Zelda: OoT
[/list]
[b]Fridays[/b]
[list]
[*]Gangplank Galleon from Donkey Kong Country 2
[*]Gangnam Style - Y'all know what this is
[*]All Of Me by Frank Sinatra
[*]Pushing Forward from VVVVVV
[*]Snakey Chantey from Donkey Kong Country 2
[*]Friday by Rebecca Black
[*]Dragostea Din Tei by O-Zone
[/list]
I have [i]tried[/i] to get the volume consistent but feel free to report if some are too quiet or, more likely, too loud. The songs are listed in order so you can edit the content.json if there are songs you don't like and want to remove.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043]Custom Music[/url].

Downloads.Description: Version of the mod with WAV files instead of OGG, for larger file size but also faster loading and possibly to fix an error with ogg files in 1.5.5. Use this one instead of the standard file.
